arguments.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
# Public debt outstanding from Treasury Bulletin (Public debt securities column)
debt_1960 = 286331  # millions
debt_1961 = 288971  # millions
debt_1962 = 298201  # millions

# CPI-U annual averages (1982-84=100 base)
cpi_1960 = 29.575
cpi_1961 = 29.891666666666666
cpi_1962 = 30.25

# Adjust to constant 1962 dollars
adjusted_1960 = debt_1960 * (cpi_1962 / cpi_1960)
adjusted_1961 = debt_1961 * (cpi_1962 / cpi_1961)

print(f"FY 1960 nominal debt: ${debt_1960} million")
print(f"FY 1961 nominal debt: ${debt_1961} million")
print(f"FY 1962 nominal debt: ${debt_1962} million")
print()
print(f"Adjusted 1960 debt (in 1962$): ${adjusted_1960} million")
print(f"Adjusted 1961 debt (in 1962$): ${adjusted_1961} million")
print()

# Absolute difference
abs_diff = abs(adjusted_1961 - adjusted_1960)
print(f"Absolute difference: ${abs_diff} million")
print(f"Rounded to thousandths: {abs_diff:.3f}")
EOF
